# Search tuning (generated by scripts/tune.py)

20 test questions. top-1 = right note ranked first. hit@3 = right note in the top 3. hit@5 = in the top 5. MRR = average of 1/rank (1.0 is perfect).

With 20 questions, one question is 5 points. A gap of one or two questions is noise, not a result. Change the config only for a clear gap, then run scripts/ingest.sh again.
